{{Quote| Vago thinks that it may be to your advantage to be somewhere else for a while. A shuttle to the family estates on Nal Hutta is waiting at dock Q2214 on level twenty-two. The pilot is expecting you.|A H-3PO droid, to Mander Zuma|<ref name="Scourge">[[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']]</ref>}}
'''Landing dock Q2114 GRB''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|landing pad]]<ref name="TF" /> located on [[level 22]]<ref name="Scourge" /> of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] that was operated by the company [[Skydove Freight]]<ref name="TF" /> during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="Scourge" />

In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], the landing dock was the site of an ambush set by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Zonnos Anjiliac Priare]]. Following the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Popara Anjiliac Diresto|Popara]]&mdash;the leader of the [[Anjiliac]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]]&mdash;Zonnos falsely accused [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mander Zuma]] and the [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] [[Reen Irana]] and [[Eddey Be'ray]] of Popara's murder,<ref name="Scourge" /> forcing the trio to go on the run.<ref name="TF" /> Zonnos had a [[H-3PO]] [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] of the Hutt [[Vago Gejalli Thokka|Vago]] send a message to the group informing them that a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] to transport the trio offworld to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] was waiting for them in landing dock Q2114 GRB.<ref name="Scourge" /> Zonnos then sent his forces to attack the fugitives upon the arrival of Zuma and his companions at the landing bay.<ref name="TF" />
